templates.default: Talk to {subject} in private
A private conversation with {subject}. It takes a block of your week and nothing goes on the record.
Address the team
Speak to the whole team with a theme. Everyone in the building hears it the same day.
Ask the captains to handle it
Hand it to the leadership council. They act only if they trust you enough to.
Apply discipline
Open a discipline case under your published standards. It is judged against how you treated the last case like it.
Change a role or the lineup
Move a player in the depth chart or change his role. The room reads the reason, not just the move.
Reassign staff work
Give a task to someone else on the staff, or take it yourself. The hours show before you confirm.
Speak in public
Take a stance at the podium, or decline to. Everyone named or implied hears it within a day.
Talk to a reporter on background
Give one reporter context away from the podium. Anything private you pass on is a leak and can be traced to you.
Tell the people above you

variants.text: Inform the owner or general manager

templates.default: Tell your boss before the story reaches them another way. You see how you stand with them, in words, before you ask.

variants.text: Tell the athletic director before the story reaches them another way. You see how you stand with them, in words, before you ask.
Tell the owner and the general manager before they hear it elsewhere. You see how you stand with them, in words, before you ask.

templates.default: Call a family member or an agent
Speak to the people behind the person. What you say is remembered by them for years.
Give time off
Excuse someone from the building. Nothing on this screen puts a price on it.
Report the matter outside

variants.text: Report to the school or compliance

templates.default: File the matter with the body that holds it. What you reported becomes a dated fact on your history.

variants.text: File the matter with the school or compliance office. Some matters must be reported, and staff who stay silent become parties if it comes out.
File the matter with the league office. What you reported becomes a dated fact on your history.

templates.default: Wait for facts
Do nothing yet. Waiting is a choice and the record keeps it as one.
